description:
Found by s527e (PPI Â§49 review probes).

REPRO (perl 5.40.3 prints stash-z; PCL main and s527e print no-z):
  *main::{HASH}->{zz} = 5; print exists $main::{zz} ? "stash-z\n" : "no-z\n";

PCL emits (p-gethash-deref (p-glob-slot (p-stash "main") "HASH") "zz"): the HASH slot of the stash glob *main:: comes back :undef, so the deref autovivifies a throwaway hash.  In perl *main::{HASH} is a reference to the stash %main:: itself.  t/op/gv.t:549 and t/uni/gv.t (*slosh::{HASH}->{ISA}=[]) use it.  Layer: runtime (p-glob-slot of a p-stash glob, HASH -> the stash as a hash).  Pre-existing: identical on main c903838f.
=== DONE (s531c, 2026-11-01): the READ half; the write is the deferred live-stash model ===
FIXED (commit df670e36) in cl/pcl-runtime.lisp: `*Pkg::` evaluates to the p-stash VIEW (a hash table registered in *p-stash-pkg-table*) and a dynamic `*{"Pkg::"}` to an EMPTY-named typeglob in Pkg; p-glob-slot took the first for a lexical filehandle (undef) and the second for an ordinary glob.  One predicate `%p-stash-glob-pkg` recognises both; `%p-stash-glob-slot` answers HASH with a reference to the same view (so keys / exists / an element value answer as `%Pkg::`), NAME / PACKAGE with the glob's own (`*Foo::Bar::` is `Bar::` in `Foo`, the main stash `main::` in `main`), GLOB with the operand, every other slot as the ordinary glob `*PARENT::NAME::`'s.
Probes (scratch/s531c/p/stash1.pl, stash2.pl, stash3.pl), = perl: `ref *main::{HASH}`, `exists *Foo::{HASH}->{bar}`, `keys %{*Foo::{HASH}}`, `defined` of an element, NAME / PACKAGE incl. nested and main, the dynamic `*{"Foo::"}{HASH}`, t/op/gv.t:549's `*slosh::{HASH}->{ISA}=[]; slosh->import` (runs).
NOT fixed, by the s522 ruling (the live stash object stays DEFERRED): the task's own repro `*main::{HASH}->{zz} = 5; exists $main::{zz}` -- a WRITE through the view is lost exactly as `$main::{zz} = 5` and `(\%main::)->{zz} = 5` are (all three probed: PCL `no`, perl yes; pre-existing).  not-supported "Live symbol-table hashes" now names the `*Pkg::{HASH}` spelling under what works and its write under what does not.  The stash glob as a VALUE (`my $g = *Foo::` prints 1, `\%Foo:: == \%Foo::` false, `*Foo::{SCALAR}` undef) filed as #4204.
Guard: Pl/t/stash-hash-01.t row 15 (fails on ade297e7).  ir-spec: "The HASH slot of a stash glob is the stash" in the stash section.  op/gv.t:549 is past the file's #1651 hang (gv.t TIMEOUTs at ~row 93), so the companion cannot show it.
subject: *main::{HASH} (the HASH slot of a STASH glob) is not the stash: *main::{HASH}->{k} = v writes nowhere (silent wrong)
